G5547.def:
**χριστός (Χρ-)**, -ή, -όν
(χρίω), [in LXX for מָשִׁיחַ and cogn. forms ;]
1. 1. as _adj._,
(a) of things, **anointing, to be used as ointment** (Æsch., Eur., al.; τ. ἔλαιον τὸ χ., [[Lev.21.10|Lev.21:10]]);
(b) of persons, **anointed** (ὁ ἰερεὺς ὁ χ., [[Lev.4.5|Lev.4:5]] οἱ χ. ἰευρεῖς, [[2Ma.1.10|2Ma.1:10]]): ὁ χ. τοῦ κυρίου or Θεοῦ ([[1Sa.2.10|1Ki.2:10]], [[Psa.2.2|Psa.2:2]], al.), of the Messiah (Aram., מְשִׁיחָא; cf. Dalman, _Words_, 289 ff.), [[Luk.2.11, 26|Luk.2:11, 26]] [[Jhn.1.41|Jhn.1:41]], [[Act.2.36; 4.26|Act.2:36 4:26]], al.
2. As subst., ὁ Χριστός, **the Messiah, the Christ**: [[Mat.2.4|Mat.2:4]], [[Mrk.8.29|Mrk.8:29]], [[Luk.2.11|Luk.2:11]], [[Jhn.1.20|Jhn.1:20]], [[Act.2.31|Act.2:31]], [[Rom.7.4|Rom.7:4]], al.; Ἰησοῦς, [[Mrk.1.1|Mrk.1:1]], [[Jhn.1.17|Jhn.1:17]], [[Act.2.38|Act.2:38]], al.; Χ. Ἰησοῦς, [[Mat.1.18|Mat.1:18]], WH, mg. [[Act.5.42|Act.5:42]], [[Rom.6.3|Rom.6:3]], al.; Χ. κύριος, [[Luk.2.11|Luk.2:11]] Ἰησοῦς Χ. ὁ κύριος, [[Act.15.26|Act.15:26]], [[Rom.1.7|Rom.1:7]], al.
(AS)

G5557.def:
**χρυσός**, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for זָהָב ;]
**gold**: [[Mat.2.11|Mat.2:11]], [[Rev.9.7|Rev.9:7]]; of golden ornaments, [[Mat.23.16-17|Mat.23:16-17]], [[1Ti.2.9|1Ti.2:9]] (Rec., WH, mg.), [[Jas.5.3|Jas.5:3]], [[Rev.17.4|Rev.17:4]] (Rec., WH, mg.) [[Rev.18.12, 16|Rev.18:12, 16]] (Rec., WH, mg.); of images, [[Act.17.29|Act.17:29]] of gold coin, [[Mat.10.9|Mat.10:9]]†
(AS)

G5537.def:
**χρηματίζω**
(χρῆμα), [in LXX: [[Jer.26.2; 29.23; 30.2; 36.2, 4|Jer.26:2 29:23 30:2 36:2, 4]] A (דָבַר pi.), [[Jer.25.30|Jer.25:30]]) (שָׁאַג), [[3Ki.18.27|3Ki.18:27]], [[Job.40.8|Job.40:8]] * ;]
1. **to transact business, hence, to consult, deliberate **(Thuc., Dem., al.); hence in later writers,
2. **to make answer **(esp. of offcial pronounce­ments by magistrates, etc.; in π. of the royal reply to an ἔντευξις, which see; cf. Deiss., BS, 122); of an answer by an oracle (Died., Plut., al.); in FlJ, LXX and NT, of divine communications, to instruct, admonish, warn: pass. (Bl., § 54, 3), [[Mat.2.22|Mat.2:22]], [[Heb.8.5; 11.7; 12.25|Heb.8:5 11:7 12:25]]; with inf. (Bl., § 69,4; 70, 3; 72, 5), [[Mat.2.12|Mat.2:12]], [[Luk.2.26|Luk.2:26]], [[Act.10.22|Act.10:22]]
3. to assume a name (as in business), **be called **(Polyb., al.): [[Act.11.26|Act.11:26]], [[Rom.7.3|Rom.7:3]] (gnomic fut.; cf. Burton, § 69).†
(AS)

G5561.def:
**χώρα**, -ας, ἡ
[in LXX for אֶרֶץ, מְדִינָה, etc. ;]
1. most frequently in cl., a space, place.
2. land, i.e.
(a) **a land, country, region**: [[Mat.12.2|Mat.12:2]], [[Mrk.5.10; 6.55|Mrk.5:10 6:55]], [[Luk.2.8; 15.13-15; 19.12|Luk.2:8 15:13-15 19:12]], [[Jhn.11.54|Jhn.11:54]], [[Act.13.49; 27.27|Act.13:49 27:27]]; χ. Γαλατική, [[Act.16.6; 18.23|Act.16:6 18:23]]; Τραχωνίτιδος, [[Luk.3.1|Luk.3:1]] τ. Ἰουδαίας, [[Act.26.20|Act.26:20]] τ. Ἰουδαίων, [[Act.10.39|Act.10:39]] pl., τῆς Ἰουδαίας κ. Σαμαρείας, [[Act.8.1|Act.8:1]] Γεργεσηνῶν (Γερασηνῶν, Γαδαρηνῶν) [[Mat.8.28|Mat.8:28]], [[Mrk.5.1|Mrk.5:1]], [[Luk.8.26|Luk.8:26]]; ἐν χ. καὶ σκιᾷ θανάτου, [[Mat.4.16|Mat.4:16]]
(b) **land, property**: [[Luk.12.16|Luk.12:16]]
(with) the country, opposite to the town; so in pl., [[Luk.21.21|Luk.21:21]], [[Jhn.4.35|Jhn.4:35]], [[Jas.5.4|Jas.5:4]].†
_SYN._: ἄγρος, τόπος (cf. _DCG_, i, 591a; LS, see word χώρα, ad init.). (AS)

G5590.def:
**ψυχή**, -ῆς, ἡ,
[in LXX very frequently for נֶפֶשׁ, sometimes for לֵבַב ,לֵב, etc. ;]
1. **breath** (Lat. anima), **breath of life, life** (Hom., al.; in Arist., of **the vital principle**): [[Mat.6.25|Mat.6:25]], [[Mrk.3.4; 10.45|Mrk.3:4 10:45]], [[Luk.12.22|Luk.12:22]], [[Jhn.10.11|Jhn.10:11]], [[Act.20.10, 24|Act.20:10, 24]] [[2Co.1.23|2Co.1:23]], [[Php.2.30|Php.2:30]], [[1Th.2.8|1Th.2:8]], al.
2. **the soul**,
(a) **as the seat of the will, desires and affections**: [[Mat.26.38|Mat.26:38]], [[Mrk.12.30|Mrk.12:30]]" (LXX) 14:34, [[Luk.1.46|Luk.1:46]], [[Jhn.10.24|Jhn.10:24]], [[Act.14.2|Act.14:2]], [[Php.1.27|Php.1:27]], al.; ἐκ ψυχῆς, **from the heart**, **heartily**: [[Eph.6.6|Eph.6:6]], [[Col.3.23|Col.3:23]];
(b) **as a periphrasis for person or self **(frequently in translation from Semitic originals, see M, _Pr._, 87; Robinson, _Gospels_, 113ff.; but also frequently in cl., see LS, see word II, 2; Edwards, _Lex._, App. A.): [[Mat.11.29|Mat.11:29]], [[Mrk.8.36|Mrk.8:36]], [[Act.2.41|Act.2:41]], [[Rom.2.9|Rom.2:9]], [[1Pe.3.20|1Pe.3:20]], al.; πᾶσα ψ., [[Act.2.43; 3.23|Act.2:43 3:23]]" (LXX), [[Rom.13.1|Rom.13:1]] ψ. ζῶσα (ζωῆς), [[1Co.15.45|1Co.15:45]], [[Rev.16.3|Rev.16:3]];
(with) **as the object of divine grace and eternal salvation**: [[Heb.13.17|Heb.13:17]], [[Jas.1.21; 5.20|Jas.1:21 5:20]], [[1Pe.1.9, 22; 2.11; 4.19, 3|1Pe.1:9, 22 2:11 4:19, 3]]Jo.2.
_SYN._: see: νοῦς, πνεῦμα, ψυχικός, and cf. _ICC_ on [[1Th.5.23|1Th.5:23]], Lft., _Notes_, 88f. (AS)

G5526.def:
**χορτάζω **
(χόρτος), [in LXX for שָׂבַע, [[Psa.17.14|Psa.17:14]] al. ;]
(a) prop., of animals (see Lft. on [[Php.4.12|Php.4:12]]), **to feed, fatten**: [[Rev.19.21|Rev.19:21]]
(b) in late Gk. (Kennedy, _Sources_, 82, 156), of persons, **to fill or satisfy with food**: with accusative of person(s), [[Mat.15.33|Mat.15:33]] pass., [[Mat.14.20; 15.37|Mat.14:20 15:37]], [[Mrk.6.42; 7.27; 8.8|Mrk.6:42 7:27 8:8]], [[Luk.9.17|Luk.9:17]], [[Jhn.6.26|Jhn.6:26]], [[Jas.2.16|Jas.2:16]]; opposite to πεινᾶν, [[Php.4.12|Php.4:12]] with genitive of thing(s), [[Mrk.8.4|Mrk.8:4]] ἀπό, [[Luk.16.21|Luk.16:21]] ἐκ, [[Luk.15.16|Luk.15:16]], WH, txt.; metaphorically, [[Mat.5.6|Mat.5:6]], [[Luk.6.21|Luk.6:21]].†
(AS)

G5574.def:
**ψεύδω ** to deceive by lies; more frequently in the depon. mid, form ψεύδομαι (so always in NT),
[in LXX chiefly for כָּחַשׁ pi. ;]
1. absol., **to lie**: [[Heb.6.18|Heb.6:18]], [[1Jn.1.6|1Jn.1:6]], [[Rev.3.9|Rev.3:9]]; οὐ ψεύδομαι, [[Rom.9.1|Rom.9:1]], [[2Co.11.31|2Co.11:31]], [[Gal.1.20|Gal.1:20]], [[1Ti.2.7|1Ti.2:7]] with dative of person(s) ([[Psa.18.45|Psa.18:45]], [[Jhn.5.12|Jhn.5:12]], al.), [[Act.5.4|Act.5:4]]; before εἰς, [[Col.3.9|Col.3:9]] κατά, [[Jas.3.14|Jas.3:14]] (Hort, in l).
2. Like act., with accusative, **to deceive by lies **(Æsch., al.): [[Act.5.3|Act.5:3]]†
(AS)

G5509.def:
**χιτών**, ῶνος, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for כְּתֹנֶת:]
the garment worn next the skin (though two tunics were sometimes worn, see Swete, _Mk._, 117), **a tunic**: [[Mat.10.10|Mat.10:10]], [[Mrk.6.9; 14.63|Mrk.6:9 14:63]], [[Luk.3.11; 9.3|Luk.3:11 9:3]], [[Jude.23|Ju 23]]; dieting. from ἱμάτιον (which see), [[Mat.5.40|Mat.5:40]], [[Luk.6.29|Luk.6:29]], [[Jhn.19.23|Jhn.19:23]], [[Act.9.39|Act.9:39]] (see _DCG_, i, 338, 340, 499)
(AS)

G5528.def:
**χόρτος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for עֶשֶׂב, also for חָצִיר, etc. ;]
1. an enclosure, a feeding place (Hom.).
2. food, esp. for cattle, **grass**: [[Mat.13.26; 14.19|Mat.13:26 14:19]], [[Mrk.4.28; 6.39|Mrk.4:28 6:39]], [[Luk.12.28|Luk.12:28]], [[Jhn.6.10|Jhn.6:10]], [[1Co.3.12|1Co.3:12]], [[Jas.1.10-11|Jas.1:10-11]], [[1Pe.1.24|1Pe.1:24]]" (LXX), [[Rev.9.4|Rev.9:4]] χ. χλωρός, [[Mrk.6.39|Mrk.6:39]], [[Rev.8.7|Rev.8:7]].†
(AS)

G5535.def:
**χρῄζω**
(χρή) [in LXX [[Jdg.11.7|Jdg.11:7]], [[1Sa.17.18|1Ki.17:18]] A * ;]
**to need, have need of**: with genitive of thing(s), [[Mat.6.32|Mat.6:32]], [[Luk.11.8; 12.30|Luk.11:8 12:30]], [[2Co.3.1|2Co.3:1]]; with genitive of person(s) before ἐν, [[Rom.16.2|Rom.16:2]]†
(AS)

G5593.def:
**ψυχρός**, -ά, -όν
(ψύχω), [in LXX: [[Pro.25.25|Pro.25:25]] (קַר), [[Sir.43.20|Sir.43:20]], [[4Ma.11.26|4Ma.11:26]] * ;]
**cold**: sc. ὕδωρ (cf. Theogn., 263; Hdt., ii, 37), [[Mat.10.42|Mat.10:42]] metaphorically, of indifferent persons, [[Rev.3.15-16|Rev.3:15-16]] †
(AS)

G5543.def:
**χρηστός**, -ή, -όν
(χράομαι), [in LXX chiefly for טוֹב (frequently of God: [[Psa.25.8|Psa.25:8]], al.), also for יָקָר ([[Ezk.27.22; 28.13|Eze.27:22 28:13]]), יָשָׁר ([[Pro.2.21|Pro.2:21]] א A) ;]
**serviceable, good**;
(a) of things, **good, pleasant**: of food (as often in cl.), οἶνος, [[Luk.5.39|Luk.5:39]] ζυγός, [[Mat.11.30|Mat.11:30]] (EV, **easy**); in ethical sense, ἤθη, [[1Co.15.33|1Co.15:33]]
(b) of persons, **good, kind, gracious**: [[Eph.4.32|Eph.4:32]] of God, [[Luk.6.35|Luk.6:35]], [[1Pe.2.3|1Pe.2:3]]; τ. χρηστὸν (= ἡ χρηστότης) τοῦ θεοῦ, [[Rom.2.4|Rom.2:4]]
† (AS)

G5562.def:
**χωρέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Gen.13.6|Gen.13:6]] (נָשָׂא), [[3Ki.7.26 7:38|3Ki.7:26 7:38]] (כּוּל hi.), [[2Ch.4.5|2Ch.4:5]] (חָזַק hi.), [[Wis.7.23-24|Wis.7:23-24]], al. ;]
I. Intrans.,
1. **to make room, give way, retire, pass**: before εἰς, [[Mat.15.17|Mat.15:17]] metaphorically (EV, come), εἰς μετάνοιαν, [[2Pe.3.9|2Pe.3:9]]
2. to go forward, advance, progress (Plat., Polyb., al.) ὁ λόγος ὁ ἐμὸς οὐ χωρεῖ. ἐν ὑμῖν, [[Jhn.8.37|Jhn.8:37]] (R, txt., hath not free course; R, mg., hath no place, for WH. cf. Field, _Notes_, 94 f.).
II. Trans., **to have space for holding, to hold**: [[Mrk.2.2|Mrk.2:2]] (cf. Ge, l.with), [[Jhn.21.25|Jhn.21:25]] of measures (1Ki, 2Ch, ll. with), [[Jhn.2.6|Jhn.2:6]] Metaphorical, of having or making room in mind or heart: [[Mat.19.11-12|Mat.19:11-12]] (EV, receive), [[2Co.7.2|2Co.7:2]] (R, txt., open your hearts; mg., make room) (cf. ἀνα-, ἀπο-, ἐκ-, ὑπο-χωρέω).†
(AS)

G5563.def:
**χωρίζω **
[in LXX: [[2Ch.12.8|2Ch.12:8]], al. (בָּדַל ni., etc.), [[Wis.1.3|Wis.1:3]], [[2Ma.5.21|2Ma.5:21]], al. ;]
1. **to separate, divide, put asunder**: with accusative of thing(s), opposite to συζεύγνυμι [[Mat.19.6|Mat.19:6]], [[Mrk.10.9|Mrk.10:9]]; with accusative of person(s), before ἀπό ([[Wis.1.3|Wis.1:3]]), [[Rom.8.35, 39|Rom.8:35, 39]]; pf. pass ptcp., [[Heb.7.26|Heb.7:26]]
2. In late writers, mid. and 1 aor pass., **to separate oneself, depart**: Phm 15; before ἀπό [[Act.1.4|Act.1:4]], ἐκ, [[Act.18.1-2;|Act.18:1-2]] of divorce (polyb., al.), [[1Co.7.10-11; 7.15|1Co.7:10-11 7:15]] (cf. ἀπο-, δια-χωρίζω).†
(AS)

G5576.def:
**ψευδο-μαρτυρέω**, -ῶ
[in LXX: [[Exo.20.16|Exo.20:16]], [[Deu.5.20|Deu.5:20]] (17) (עָנָה), Da TH [[Sus.1.61|Su 1:61]] AB2R (see ψευδομάρτυς) * ;]
**to bear false witness**: [[Mat.19.18|Mat.19:18]], [[Mrk.10.19|Mrk.10:19]], [[Luk.18.20|Luk.18:20]]" (LXX) ; before κατά, with genitive of person(s), [[Mrk.14.56-57|Mrk.14:56-57]] (Xen., Plat., al.).†
(AS)

G5594.def:
**ψύχω **
[in LXX for קוּר, שָׁטַח ;]
**to breathe, blow**; hence, to make cool. Pass., **to grow cool**: metaphorically, [[Mat.24.12|Mat.24:12]]†
(AS)

G5580.def:
**ψευδό-χριστος**, -ου ὁ
a false Christ or Messiah, "a pretender to the Messianic office" (Swete, _Mk._, 309; cf. also Tr., _Syn._, § xxx): [[Mat.24.24|Mat.24:24]], [[Mrk.13.22|Mrk.13:22]] (cf. ἀντίχριστος).†
(AS)

G5549.def:
**χρονίζω**
(χρόνος), [in LXX chiefly for אָחַר pi. ;]
**to spend or take time, to tarry, linger, delay**: [[Mat.24.48; 25.5|Mat.24:48 25:5]], [[Heb.10.37|Heb.10:37]]; before ἐν, with dative loc., [[Luk.1.21|Luk.1:21]] with inf., [[Luk.12.45|Luk.12:45]]†
(AS)

G5575.def:
**ψευδο-μάρτυς**, -υρος, ὁ
[in LXX: Dan LXX [[Sus.1.60-61|Su 1:60-61]] Bl * ;]
**a false witness**: [[Mat.26.60|Mat.26:60]] with genitive obj. (see WM, § 30, 1a), [[1Co.15.15|1Co.15:15]]†
(AS)

G5511.def:
**χλαμύς**, -ύδος, ἡ
[in LXX: [[2Ma.12.35|2Ma.12:35]] * ;]
**a chlamys, or short cloak worn over the χιτών **(which see): [[Mat.27.28, 31|Mat.27:28, 31]] (see Tr., _Syn._, § 1).†
(AS)

G5521.def:
**χολή**, -ῆς, ἡ
[in LXX for רֹאשׁ, לַעֲנָה, מְרֵרָה ;]
**gall**: [[Mat.27.34|Mat.27:34]] (here prob. = myrrh, cf. [[Mrk.15.23|Mrk.15:23]], see Swete, in l; _DCG_, i, 634); metaphorically, [[Act.8.23|Act.8:23]]†
(AS)

G5510.def:
**χιών**, -όνος, ἡ
[in LXX chiefly for שֶׁלֶג also (in Da) for תְּלַג ;]
**snow**: [[Mat.28.3|Mat.28:3]], [[Rev.1.14|Rev.1:14]].†
(AS)

G5522.def:
**χοῦς**, -οός accusative, οῦν, ὁ, (contr. from χόος),
[in LXX chiefly for עָפָר ;]
1. earth, soil.
2. In later writers (Pint., LXX), = κονιορτός, **dust**: [[Mrk.6.11|Mrk.6:11]], [[Rev.18.19|Rev.18:19]].†
(AS)

G5506.def:
**χιλίαρχος** (in Hdt., al., -ης), -ου, ὁ
(χίλιοι, ἄρχω) [in LXX chiefly for אַלּוּף שַׂר ;]
a chiliarch, the commander of a thousand, esp. a Roman military tribune, the commander of a cohort: [[Jhn.18.12|Jhn.18:12]], [[Act.21.31-33, 37; 22.24-29; 23.10, 15; 23.17-19, 22; 24.7, 22; 25.23|Act.21:31-33, 37 22:24-29 23:10, 15 23:17-19, 22 24:7, 22 25:23]]; more generally, of officers of similar rank, [[Mrk.6.21|Mrk.6:21]], [[Rev.6.15; 19.18|Rev.6:15 19:18]] (see, _DB_, i, 352b; _DCG_, i, 271a, 307a).†
(AS)

G5515.def:
**χλωρός**, -ά, -όν
(χλόη), [in LXX for יֶרֶק, etc. ;]
(a) **pale green**: χόρτος, [[Mrk.6.39|Mrk.6:39]], [[Rev.8.7|Rev.8:7]]; πᾶν χ., [[Rev.9.4|Rev.9:4]]
(b) **pale**: ἵππος, [[Rev.6.8|Rev.6:8]]†
(AS)

G5536.def:
**χρῆμα**, -τος, τό
(χράομαι) [in LXX: [[Jos.22.8|Jos.22:8]], [[2Ch.1.11-12|2Ch.1:11-12]] (נֶכֶס), [[Job.27.17|Job.27:17]] (כֶּסֶף), etc.; frequently in Sir (5:1, 8, al.), 2 and 4 Mac ;]
**a thing that one uses or needs **(and generally, a matter, event, business); hence in pl.,
(a) **wealth, riches**: οἱ τά χ. ἔχοντες, [[Mrk.10.23-24|Mrk.10:23-24]], [[Luk.18.24|Luk.18:24]];
(b) **money**: [[Act.8.18, 20; 24.26|Act.8:18, 20 24:26]]; sing. (rare in cl.) of a special sum of money, [[Act.4.37|Act.4:37]]†
(AS)

G5548.def:
**χρίω **
**to anoint** (Hom., al.);
[in LXX chiefly for מָשַׁח of consecration to a sacred office: priest, [[Exo.28.41|Exo.28:41]] prophet, [[1Ki.19.16|3Ki.19:16]] king, [[1Sa.10.1|1Ki.10:1]] of things, [[Exo.40.9|Exo.40:9]], [[Lev.8.10|Lev.8:10]], al.].
In NT, metaphorically, of God's anointing,
(a) **Christ**: [[Act.4.27|Act.4:27]] with inf., [[Luk.4.18|Luk.4:18]] (LXX); with dupl. accusative (see B1., § 34, 4), [[Heb.1.9|Heb.1:9]] (LXX); πνεύματι ἁγίῳ, [[Act.10.38|Act.10:38]]
(b) **Christians**: [[2Co.1.21|2Co.1:21]] (cf. Westc., _Epp. Jo._, 73) (cf. ἐν-, ἐπι-Χριω).†
**SYN**: see: ἀλείφω
(AS)

G5597.def:
**ψώχω**
(ψώω, collat. form of ψάω, to rub)
**to rub**: [[Luk.6.1|Luk.6:1]]†
(AS)

G5533.def:
**χρεοφειλέτης** (Rec. χρεω-, WH, χρεοφιλ-; see WH, _App._, 152, 154), -ου, ὁ,
(χρέος, a debt, + ὀφειλέτης) [in LXX: [[Job.31.37|Job.31:37]], [[Pro.29.13|Pro.29:13]] * ;]
**a debtor**: [[Luk.7.41; 16.5|Luk.7:41 16:5]].†
(AS)

G5531.def:
**χράω**, κίχρημι
[in LXX for לָוָה, etc. ;]
**to lend**: [[Luk.11.5|Luk.11:5]]†
(AS)

G5585.def:
**ψηφίζω**
(ψῆφος), [in LXX: [[3Ki.3.8 8:5|3Ki.3:8 8:5]] A (סָפַר ni..) * ;]
to count (prop., with pebbles), **reckon, calculate**: τ. δαπάνην, [[Luk.14.28|Luk.14:28]] τ. ἀριθμόν (i.e. calculate the number's meaning), [[Rev.13.18|Rev.13:18]] (in cl. chiefly mid., to vote by casting a pebble; cf. συγ-κατα-, συμ-φηφίζω).†
(AS)

G5525.def:
**χορός**, -οῦ, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for מָחוֹל, מְחֹלָה ;]
**a dance**: pl., [[Luk.15.26|Luk.15:25]]†
(AS)

G5568.def:
**ψαλμός**, -οῦ, ὁ
(ψάλλω), [in LXX chiefly for מִזְמוֹר ;]
1. a striking, twitching with the fingers (Eur., al.), hence, a striking of musical strings (Æsch., a1.), and hence in later writers,
2. a sacred song sung to musical accompaniment, a psalm (LXX): [[1Co.14.26|1Co.14:26]], [[Eph.5.19|Eph.5:19]], [[Col.3.16|Col.3:16]]; of OT psalms, [[Luk.24.44|Luk.24:44]], [[Act.13.33|Act.13:33]]; βίβλος ψαλμῶν, [[Luk.20.42|Luk.20:42]], [[Act.1.20|Act.1:20]].†
_SYN._: see: ὕμνος (AS)

G5584.def:
**ψηλαφάω**, -ῶ
(ψάω, to touch), [in LXX for מוּשׁ, מָשַׁשׁ pi., etc. ;]
1. **to feel or grope about**; with accusative, **to feel about for, search after**: metaphorically, of seeking God, [[Act.17.27|Act.17:27]]
2. **to feel, touch, handle**: with accusative of person(s), [[Luk.24.39|Luk.24:39]], [[1Jn.1.1|1Jn.1:1]]; προσεληλύθατε ψηλαφωμένῳ (ὄρει ?), [[Heb.12.18|Heb.12:18]] (R, txt., a mount that might be touched; mg., a palpable and kindled fire; see Westc., in l).†
(AS)

G5504.def:
**ἐχθές**
(Rec. χθές), adv., [in LXX for תְּמוֹל, etc. ;]
**yesterday**: [[Jhn.4.52|Jhn.4:52]], [[Act.7.28|Act.7:28]], [[Heb.13.8|Heb.13:8]] (on the form, see Rutherford, _NPhr._, 370 f.).†
** ἐχθές**,
_adverb_ ={χθές}, **yesterday**, ( 5th-6th c.BC: Aristophanes Comicus “Nubes” 175, “Th.” 616, etc.; ἀπ᾽ ἐ. “Anthologia Graeca” 11.35 (1st c.BC: Philodemus Gadarensis Epigrammaticus); μέσφα τό γ᾽ ἐ. 3rd c.BC: Theocritus Poeta Bucolicus 2.144 ); οὐ γάρ τι νῦν γε κἀ. today or **yesterday**, ( 5th c.BC: Sophocles Tragicus “Antigone” 456; οὐκ ἐ. οὐδὲ πρῴην 5th c.BC: Antipho Orator “fragment” 58 ); ἐ. καὶ τρίτης [ἡμέρας] ( LXX.Ruth.2.11, compare 2nd c.AD: Marcus Antoninus Imperator 10.7. (ἐχθές is commoner than χθές) in Comedy texts and LXX, is the only form used in “NT”, and frequently in papyri of all periods, ( “PSI” 4.442.21 (3rd c.BC), etc.)) (AS)

G5520.def:
**χολάω**, -ῶ
(χολή), [in LXX: [[3Ma.3.1|3Ma.3:1]] R * ;]
1. to be melancholy mad (Aristoph.).
2. **= χολοῦμαι, to be angry**: with dative of person(s), [[Jhn.7.23|Jhn.7:23]]†
(AS)

G5579.def:
**ψεῦδος**, -εος (-ους), τό
[in LXX chiefly for שֶׁקֶר, also for כַּחַשׁ, כָּזָב ;]
**a falsehood, untruth, lie**: [[Rev.14.15|Rev.14:15]] opposite to ἡ ἀλήθεια, [[Jhn.8.44|Jhn.8:44]], [[Rom.1.25|Rom.1:25]], [[Eph.4.25|Eph.4:25]], [[2Th.2.11|2Th.2:11]], [[1Jn.2.21|1Jn.2:21]]; to τὸ ἀληθές, [[1Jn.2.27|1Jn.2:27]] ποιεῖν ψ., [[Rev.21.27; 22.15|Rev.21:27 22:15]]; ἐν πάσῃ δυνάμει κ. σημείοις κ. τέρασιν ψεύδους (genitive qual., see M, _Th._, 104; and on the meaning and construction, see also _ICC_, in l), [[2Th.2.9|2Th.2:9]]†
(AS)

G5596.def:
**ψωμίον**, -ου, τό
dimin. of ψωμός, **a fragment, morsel**: [[Jhn.13.26-27, 30|Jhn.13:26-27, 30]].†
(AS)

G5553.def:
**χρυσίον**, -ου, τό
(dimin. of χρυσός, which see), [in LXX chiefly for זָהָב ;]
**a piece of gold, gold**: [[1Co.3.12|1Co.3:12]], [[Heb.9.4|Heb.9:4]], [[1Pe.1.7|1Pe.1:7]], [[Rev.3.18; 21.18, 21|Rev.3:18 21:18, 21]]; of golden ornaments, [[1Ti.2.9|1Ti.2:9]] (WH, txt., RV), [[1Pe.3.3|1Pe.3:3]], [[Rev.17.4; 18.16|Rev.17:4 18:16]] (WH, txt., R); of gold coin, money, [[Act.3.6; 20.33|Act.3:6 20:33]], [[1Pe.1.18|1Pe.1:18]].†
(AS)

G5571.def:
**ψευδής**, -ές
(ψεύδομαι), [in LXX for שֶׁקֶר, שָׁוְא, כָּזָב; etc. ;]
**lying, false, untrue **(of persons and things): [[Rev.2.2|Rev.2:2]] μάρτυρες, [[Act.6.13|Act.6:13]] as subst., ὁ ψ., **a liar**: [[Rev.21.8|Rev.21:8]]†
(AS)

G5546.def:
**Χριστιανός** (D, Χρεισ-; on the form Χρησ-, see Bl., § 3, 6; 27, 4 on the ending, -ανος, see Bl., ll. with; Deiss., _LAE_, 382), -οῦ ὁ,
**a Christian, the name first given to the disciples by pagan gentiles at Antioch**: [[Act.11.26; 26.28|Act.11:26 26:28]], [[1Pe.4.16|1Pe.4:16]] (see reff. in Thayer, see word; also _DB_, i, 384).†
(AS)

G5500.def:
**χειρο-τονέω**, -ῶ
(χείρ, τείνω)
1. to vote by stretching out the hand in the Athenian ἐκκλησία (Luc., Plut.).
2. **to appoint**:
(a) by vote, [[2Co.8.19|2Co.8:19]]
(b) without vote, [[Act.14.23|Act.14:23]] (see Rackham, in l) (cf. προχειροτονέω).†
(AS)

G5559.def:
**χρώς**, genitive, χρωτός, ὁ
[in LXX chiefly for בָּשָׂר ;]
in cl. rare in prose, the surface of the body, **skin**: [[Act.19.12|Act.19:12]]†
(AS)

G5508.def:
**χίος**, -ου, ἡ
**Chios, an island in Ægean Sea**: [[Act.20.15|Act.20:15]]†
(AS)

G5586.def:
**ψῆφος**, -ου, ἡ
(ψάω, to rub) [in LXX: [[Exo.4.25|Exo.4:25]] (צֹר), [[Lam.3.16|La 3:16]] (חָצָץ), [[Ecc.7.26|Ecc.7:26]] (25) (צֹר), [[2Ki.12.4|4Ki.12:4]] (5) A, [[Sir.18.10|Sir.18:10]], [[4Ma.15.26|4Ma.15:26]] * ;]
1. **a small smooth stone, a pebble**: ψ. λευκή (for suggestions as to the meaning, see Swete, in l), [[Rev.2.17|Rev.2:17]]
2. **From the use of pebbles in voting, a vote**: [[Act.26.10|Act.26:10]]†
(AS)

G5530.def:
**χράομαι**, χρῶμαι
(χρή), [in LXX for עָשָׂה, etc. ;]
**to use, make use of**: with dative (cf. M, _Pr._, 64, 158), [[Act.27.17|Act.27:17]], [[1Co.9.12; 9.15|1Co.9:12 9:15]], [[1Ti.1.8; 5.23|1Ti.1:8 5:23]]; μᾶλλον χρῆσαι (i.e. the opportunity; see M, _Pr._, 247), [[1Co.7.21|1Co.7:21]] as some­times in late writers (cf. M, _Pr._, 64; Lft., _Notes_, 233), with accusative, [[1Co.7.31|1Co.7:31]] of feelings, etc., **to exercise, shew**: [[2Co.1.17; 3.12|2Co.1:17 3:12]]; with adv., ἀποτόμως, to deal sharply, [[2Co.13.10|2Co.13:10]] with dative of person(s) (cl.), to treat, deal with, [[Act.27.3|Act.27:3]]†
(AS)

G5540.def:
**χρῆσις**, -εως, ἡ
(χράομαι), [in LXX: [[1Sa.1.28|1Ki.1:28]] (שָׁאַל), [[Sir.18.8|Sir.18:8]], al. ;]
**use**: in a sexual sense, [[Rom.1.26|Rom.1:26]] with genitive obj., θηλείας, [[Rom.1.27|Rom.1:27]] (for exx., see Thayer, see word).†
(AS)

G5588.def:
**ψιθυριστής**, -οῦ, ὁ
(see supr.),
**a whisperer **(as epithet of Hermes, Dem., 1358, 6): in bad sense, [[Rom.1.30|Rom.1:30]]†
_Syn._: καταλάλος, q.v
(AS)

G5544.def:
**χρηστότης**, -ητος, ἡ
(χρηστός), [in LXX for טוּב and cogn. forms ;]
1. **goodness, excellence, uprightness**: [[Rom.3.12|Rom.3:12]] (LXX).
2. **goodness of heart, kindness**: [[Rom.2.4|Rom.2:4]], [[2Co.6.6|2Co.6:6]], [[Gal.5.22|Gal.5:22]], [[Col.3.12|Col.3:12]], [[Tit.3.4|Tit.3:4]]; before ἐπί, with accusative of person(s), [[Eph.2.7|Eph.2:7]] id., opposite to ἀποτομία, [[Rom.11.22|Rom.11:22]]
_SYN._: see: ἀγαθωσύνη. (AS)

G5582.def:
**ψεῦσμα**, -τος, τό
(ψεύδω), [in Aq., _Th._: [[Job.34.6|Job.34:6]], [[Pro.23.3|Pro.23:3]]; in Sm.: [[Job.13.4|Job.13:4]], al. ;]
**a lie, falsehood**: [[Rom.3.7|Rom.3:7]] (Plat., Plut. al.).†
(AS)

G5538.def:
**χρηματισμός**, -οῦ), ὁ
(χρηματίζω, which see), [in LXX: [[Pro.31.1|Pro.31:1]] (מַשָּׂא), [[2Ma.2.4|2Ma.2:4]] [[2Mac.11.17|2Mac 11:17]] * ;]
**a divine response, an oracle**: [[Rom.11.4|Rom.11:4]] (Xen., Plat., al.).†
(AS)

G5595.def:
**ψωμίζω**
(ψωμός, a morsel), [in LXX chiefly for אָכַל hi. ;]
to feed with morsels (as children or the sick; Hippocr.), hence, generally, **in late writers, to feed, nourish**: with accusative of person(s), [[Rom.12.20|Rom.12:20]] (LXX); with accusative of thing(s), to give out for food, [[1Co.13.3|1Co.13:3]] (cf. WM, § 32, 4an; for dupl. accusative, cf. [[Num.11.4|Num.11:4]], [[Sir.15.3|Sir.15:3]], al.).†
(AS)

G5567.def:
**ψάλλω **
[in LXX chiefly for זָמַר pi. ([[Jdg.5.3|Jdg.5:3]], [[Psa.7.17|Psa.7:17]], al.), also for נָגַן pi. ([[1Sa.16.16|1Ki.16:16]] ff, al.) ;]
1. to pull, twitch, twang (as a bowstring, etc.; Æsch., Eur., al.), hence,
2. absol.,
(a) **to play a stringed instrument with the fingers **(Hdt., Plat., al.);
(b) later, to sing to a harp, sing psalms (LXX); in NT, **to sing a hymn, sing praise**: [[Jas.5.13|Jas.5:13]] with dative of person(s), [[Rom.15.9|Rom.15:9]] (LXX), [[Eph.5.19|Eph.5:19]] dative instr., [[1Co.14.15|1Co.14:15]]†
(AS)

G5542.def:
**χρηστολογία**, -ας, ἡ
(χρηστός, λέγω),
**fair speaking**: in bad sense, [[Rom.16.18|Rom.16:18]] (in good sense also, eccl.).†
(AS)

G5591.def:
**ψυχικός**, -ή, -όν
(ψυχή) [in LXX: [[4Ma.1.32|4Ma.1:32]] * ;]
of the ψυχή (as the lower part of the immaterial in man), **EV, natural**: opposite to πνευματικός, [[1Co.2.14; 15.44; 15.46|1Co.2:14 15:44 15:46]]; πνεῦμα μὴ ἔχοντες (EV, sensual; R, mg., natural or animal; better perhaps, of the mind; see infr.), [[Jude.19|Ju 19]]; with ἐπίγειος, δαιμονιώδης, opposite to ἄνωθεν κατερχομένη (σοψία), of the mind (Hort, in l), [[Jas.3.15|Jas.3:15]]†
(AS)

G5524.def:
**χορηγέω**, -ῶ
(χορός, ἡγέομαι) [in LXX for כּוּל pilp. ;]
1. to lead a χορός (see LS, see word).
2. to defray the cost of a χορός.
3. In late writers, metaphorically, with accusative (see M, _Pr._, 65), **to supply, furnish abundantly**: [[2Co.9.10|2Co.9:10]], [[1Pe.4.11|1Pe.4:11]] (Polyb., al.).†
(AS)

G5569.def:
**ψευδ-άδελφος**, -ου, ὁ
**a false brother**: of professing Christians, [[2Co.11.26|2Co.11:26]], [[Gal.2.4|Gal.2:4]].†
(AS)

G5581.def:
**ψευδώνυμος**, -ον
(ψευδής, ὄνομα)
**under a false name, falsely called**: [[1Ti.6.20|1Ti.6:20]] (Æsch., Plut., a1.).†
(AS)

G5552.def:
**Χρύσεος**, -εα, -εον (-οῦς, -ῆ, -οῦν; on accusative sing. fem., -ᾶν, [[Rev.1.13|Rev.1:13]] and genitive pl. uncontr., -εων, [[Rev.2.1|Rev.2:1]], LTr., see M, _Pr._, 48 and cf. Thackeray, _Gr._, x, 172 f.)
(χρυσός), [in LXX chiefly for זָהָב ;]
golden, i.e. made or overlaid with gold: [[2Ti.2.20|2Ti.2:20]], [[Heb.9.4|Heb.9:4]], [[Rev.1.12-13, 20; 2.1; 4.4; 5.8; 8.3; 9.13, 20; 14.14; 15.6-7; 17.4; 21.15|Rev.1:12-13, 20 2:1 4:4 5:8 8:3 9:13, 20 14:14 15:6-7 17:4 21:15]].†
(AS)

G5502.def:
**Χερουβείν** (Rec. -βίμ), τά (Heb. כְּרוּב),
**Cherubim**: [[Heb.9.6|Heb.9:6]] (cf. [[Exo.25.17|Exo.25:17]] (18), al.; see _DB_, i, 377 ff.).†
(AS)

G5534.def:
**χρή ** impers.
(χράω, see LS, see word),
**it is necessary**: [[Jas.3.10|Jas.3:10]] (cf. δεῖ.).†
(AS)

G5545.def:
**χρίσμα** (T, χρῖσμα, as in cl.; see Tdf., _Pr._, 102; Bl., § 4, 2), -τος, το
(χρίω),
later form of χρῖμα (Æsch., al.),
[in LXX for מִשְׁחָה and cogn. forms ([[Exo.29.7|Exo.29:7]], al.) ;]
**an anointing, unction **(the result of the action χρίειν; _ICC_, in l; but cf. Westc., in l, for the view that the oil, not the act, is meant): [[1Jn.2.20|1Jn.2:20]] [[Jhn.2.27|Jn 2:27]].†
(AS)

G5598.def:
**Ω, ω, ὦ μέγα** (cf. ὂ μικρόν),
omega, ô, the twenty-fourth and last letter. As a numeral, ω᾽ = 800, ω, = 800,000. As a symbol of the last (= τὸ τέλος), τὸ Ὦ (Rec. Ω, L, ὦ, T, ω), **the Omega**: [[Rev.1.8; 21.6; 22.13|Rev.1:8 21:6 22:13]] (cf. Ἄλφα).†
(AS)

G5513.def:
**χλιαρός**, -ά, -όν
(χλίω, to become warm),
**warm, tepid**; metaphorically, of persons, **luke-warm**: [[Rev.3.16|Rev.3:16]]†
(AS)

G5518.def:
**χοῖνιξ**, -ικος, ἡ
[in LXX: [[Ezk.45.10-11|Eze.45:10-11]] (בַּת) * ;]
**a chænix, a dry measure of rather less than a quart**: [[Rev.6.6|Rev.6:6]] (EV, measure).†
(AS)

G5558.def:
**χρυσόω**, -ῶ
(χρυσός) [in LXX chiefly for צָפָה pi. ;]
**to gild, cover with gold**: pass., with dative, χρυσίῳ (pleonast., cf. [[Exo.26.37|Exo.26:37]]), [[Rev.17.4; 18.16|Rev.17:4 18:16]].†
(AS)

G5555.def:
**χρυσό-λιθος**, -ου, ὁ
[in LXX: [[Exo.28.20; 36.20|Exo.28:20 36:20]] ([[Exo.39.13|Exo.39:13]]), [[Ezk.28.13|Eze.28:13]] (תַּרְשִׁישׁ) * ;]
**a chrysolite **(on its identification, see Swete, Ap., 288 f.; _DB_, iv, 620): [[Rev.21.20|Rev.21:20]]†
(AS)
